data.name: Sreeleela
data.long_meaning: The name Sreeleela is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Sree’ which means wealth or goddess and ‘Leela’ which means play or music. It is the name of the goddess Lakshmi who is often depicted playing the Veena. This name symbolizes the divine play of the goddess and her connection to music and art.

data.numerology_meaning: The name Sreeleela is a 3 life path number which represents creativity, self-expression, and artistic ability. Those with this name are often drawn to the arts and have a natural talent for self-expression.
